        How to play

        The game

        Runners cross the field to the safe line, then back again on the next crossing. Hunters guard the middle. Every runner who is caught becomes a hunter. The last runner standing wins.

        Moving

        Drag to move. Push the stick all the way, or hold Sprint (Shift on a keyboard), to sprint. Sprinting drains the stamina bar; ease off and it refills. Run out and you are winded for a moment.

        Vaulting

        Sprint straight at a low obstacle, such as a rock, crate, bench, fence or cone, and you hop over it. Tall walls, stalls and towers block everyone.

        Hunters

        Hunters are faster than every runner. Touch a runner to catch them: the red ring around you is your reach. The round button uses your weapon.

          Runners

          Each runner has one special move on the round button.

            When a touch does not count

            A blue bubble is a shield: the first touch pops it and shows BLOCKED. A runner in the air from a High jump cannot be caught. Nobody can be caught inside a safe zone, and hunters cannot enter one.

            Reading the screen

            A red glow at the edges means a hunter is close, and your heartbeat gets faster. In the 3D modes a red arrow points to the nearest hunter, even behind you. The corner shows who caught whom. You hear footsteps from the side they come from.

            Power-ups

            Speed is a 4 second boost. Shield blocks one catch. Freeze slows the other team around you.
